purpose: Controlled registry for blogs, videos, podcasts and other external Human Design sources used to enrich practical interpretation without overriding deterministic mechanics.

source_tiers.P0: Deterministic mechanics. Generated by the Know Yourself engine; absolute authority for chart calculation.
source_tiers.P1: Primary or lineage-controlled Human Design teaching. May define or explain system concepts, but never replaces deterministic calculation.
source_tiers.P2: Established teacher/practitioner material with identifiable lineage, authorship and sustained teaching record. Useful for interpretation and practical application.
source_tiers.P3: Community/practical content. Useful for lived examples, language, questions and patterns; never treated as mechanical truth.
source_tiers.P4: Critical, comparative or independent commentary. Useful for limitations, disagreement and perspective; never used to alter chart mechanics.

sources.name: Jovian Archive
sources.lineage: Official Human Design source associated with Ra Uru Hu's teachings.
sources.rights_policy: Store metadata and concise paraphrase/provenance. Do not reproduce copyrighted source text. Use official sharing permissions where explicitly granted.

sources.lineage: Official Jovian Archive platform for Ra Uru Hu video teachings.
sources.rights_policy: Prefer metadata, source links and licensed/authorized material. Do not ingest or reproduce restricted media without rights.

sources.rights_policy: Store metadata, source links, concise paraphrase and provenance. Do not reproduce copyrighted posts, videos, images or transcripts unless rights explicitly permit fuller use.

sources.rights_policy: Store URL, metadata and concise paraphrase only; do not reproduce source text. Treat gate-grouping data as provisional pending primary-source validation.
